Inputs are integers. Do not change the public function name. Make the edit and check the behavior. /no_think

files.solution.py:
def clamp(value, lower, upper):

entries.goal: Fix the Python implementation in solution.py. Repair rotate_left(items, steps): return a new list rotated left by integer steps modulo the list length. Negative steps rotate right. Empty input returns a new empty list. Preserve elements and do not mutate the input. Make the edit and check the behavior. /no_think

files.solution.py:
def rotate_left(items, steps):

entries.goal: Fix the Python implementation in solution.py. Repair overlap_length(a_start, a_end, b_start, b_end): endpoints are integers defining half-open intervals. Raise ValueError if either start exceeds its end. Return the nonnegative length of the intersection. Empty or merely adjacent intervals have intersection length zero. Make the edit and check the behavior. /no_think

files.solution.py:
def overlap_length(a_start, a_end, b_start, b_end):
    return min(a_end,b_end)-max(a_start,b_start)

def round_robin(left, right):
    return [item for pair in zip(left,right) for item in pair]
